answer.reason: The verses name Rechab only as the father of Jehonadab or the ancestor of the Rechabites and record no deed or event of Rechab himself, so they say no more than the summary does.
doubts: The marked verses mostly concern Jehonadab (Jonadab) and the Rechabites, not Rechab himself.
1CH 2:55 may refer to a different Rechab or to a clan name, not necessarily the father of Jehonadab.
